import bisect

def lower_bound(A: list, v: int) -> int:
    l, r = -1, len(A)
    while r - l > 1:
        m = (r + l) // 2
        if A[m] < v:
            l = m
        else:
            r = m
    return r


def count(A: list, a: int, b: int) -> int:
    l = bisect.bisect_left(A, a)
    u = bisect.bisect_left(A, b)
    # l = lower_bound(A, a)
    # u = lower_bound(A, b)
    return u - l


def two_sequences(N: int, A: list, B: list) -> int:
    BIT_LIM = 40

    res = 0
    for k in range(BIT_LIM):
        T = 1 << (k+1)
        sorted_B = sorted(b & (T-1) for b in B)
        num_kth_bit_is_1 = 0
        for ai in A:
            ai_mod = ai & (T-1)

            T = T >> 1
            num_kth_bit_is_1 += count(sorted_B, T - ai_mod, 2*T - ai_mod)
            num_kth_bit_is_1 += count(sorted_B, 3*T - ai_mod, 4*T - ai_mod)
            T = T << 1

        res = ((num_kth_bit_is_1 & 1) << k) | res

    return res

marge :: Ord a => VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> ST s ()
marge u v ret
  | VM.null u = VM.copy ret v
  | VM.null v = VM.copy ret u
  | otherwise = do
        x <- VM.read u 0
        y <- VM.read v 0
        if x > y then marge v u ret else do
            VM.write ret 0 x
            marge (VM.tail u) v (VM.tail ret)

testMarge :: V.Vector Int
testMarge = runST $ do
    x <- V.thaw $ V.fromList ([1, 4] :: [Int])
    y <- V.thaw $ V.fromList ([2, 3] :: [Int])
    res <- VM.new 4
    marge x y res
    V.freeze res

msort :: Ord a => V.Vector a -> V.Vector a
msort v = runST $ do
    v' <- V.thaw v
    work <- VM.new $ VM.length v'
    msort_ v' work
    V.unsafeFreeze v'

msort_ :: Ord a => VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> ST s ()
msort_ v work
  | VM.length v <= 1 = return ()
  | otherwise        = do
        VM.copy lwork lv
        VM.copy rwork rv
        msort_ lwork lv
        msort_ rwork rv
        marge lwork rwork v
        where
            toHalf vm = VM.splitAt (VM.length vm `div` 2) vm
            (lv, rv) = toHalf v
            (lwork, rwork) = toHalf work

binarySearch :: VU.Vector Int -> (Int, Int) -> Int -> Int
binarySearch xs (al, ar) y = go al ar where
    go l r
        | l == r = l
        | x < y = go (m + 1) r
        | x >= y = go l m
        where m = (r + l) `shiftR` 1
              x = xs `VU.unsafeIndex` m

upperBoundImpl key (l, r) f =
    let mid = (l + r) `unsafeShiftR` 1
    in  if r - l <= 1 then r else
        if f `VU.unsafeIndex` mid <= key
            then upperBoundImpl key (mid, r) f
            else upperBoundImpl key (l, mid) f

upperBound :: Int -> (Int, Int) -> VU.Vector Int -> Int
upperBound key (l, r) = upperBoundImpl key (l - 1, r)

unsafeBit = (1 `unsafeShiftL`)

xorOnFigure :: Int -> Int -> VU.Vector Int -> Int
xorOnFigure a k sorted =
    let n = VU.length sorted
        --notCarriers = upperBound (unsafeBit (k + 1) - 1 - a) (0, n) sorted
        --i = upperBound (unsafeBit k - 1 - a) (0, n) sorted
        --j = upperBound (unsafeBit k * 3 - 1 - a) (0, n) sorted
        notCarriers = binarySearch sorted (0, n) $ bit (k + 1)
        i = binarySearch sorted (0, notCarriers) $ bit k
        j = binarySearch sorted (notCarriers, n) $ bit (k + 1) + bit k
    in  (notCarriers - i) + (n - j)

eachFigure :: Int -> [Int] -> [Int] -> Int
eachFigure k as sortedBs =
    let v = VU.fromList $ (.&. (unsafeBit (k + 1) - 1)) <$> sortedBs
        f a = xorOnFigure a k v
    in  foldr1 xor $ map f $! (.&. (unsafeBit (k + 1) - 1)) <$> as

eachFigure' :: [Int] -> [Int] -> Int -> Int
eachFigure' as bs k =
    let v = sort' $ VU.fromList $ (.&. (unsafeBit (k + 1) - 1)) <$> bs
        f a = xorOnFigure a k v
    in  if odd $ sum $ map f $ (.&. (unsafeBit (k + 1) - 1)) <$> as
        then unsafeBit k
        else 0

-- https://github.com/as-capabl/haskell-qsort-pfm/blob/master/src/UV.hs
type IndType = Int

quicksort :: VUM.STVector s Int -> IndType -> IndType -> ST s ()
quicksort work iStart iEnd
    | iEnd - iStart <= 1 = return ()
    | otherwise =
        do
        pivot <- VUM.unsafeRead work ((iEnd + iStart) `shiftR` 1)
        med <- divide pivot iStart (iEnd - 1)
        quicksort work iStart med
        quicksort work med iEnd
    where
    divide pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            lower <- shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
            higher <- shrinkHigher pivot lower iE'
            if lower >= higher
                then return lower
                else do
                swapWork lower higher
                divide pivot (lower + 1) (higher - 1)

    shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iS'
            if x >= pivot
                then
                return iS'
                else
                shrinkLower pivot (iS' + 1) iE'

    shrinkHigher pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iE'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iE'
            if x <= pivot
                then
                return iE'
                else
                shrinkHigher pivot iS' (iE' - 1)

    swapWork = VUM.unsafeSwap work

{-# INLINE sortv #-}
sortv :: (a->a->Bool) -> MV.STVector s a -> Int -> Int -> ST s ()
sortv f as b e = do
        l <- MV.unsafeRead as b
        r <- MV.unsafeRead as e
        p <- findP l (b+1) e
        case p of
            Nothing -> return ()
            Just piv -> do
                k <- partv f as piv b e
                sortv f as b (k-1)
                sortv f as k e
    where
        findP a i e
            | i > e = return Nothing
            | True = do
                k <- MV.unsafeRead as i
                case (f a k, f k a) of
                    (True, _) -> return $ Just k
                    (_, True) -> return $ Just a
                    _ -> findP a (i+1) e

partv :: (a->a->Bool) -> MV.STVector s a -> a -> Int -> Int -> ST s Int
partv f as piv b e = do
    MV.unsafeSwap as b e
    l <- findF b
    r <- findT e
    if l <= r then partv f as piv l r
              else return l
    where
        findF i = do
            k <- MV.unsafeRead as i
            if f k piv then findF (i+1) else return i
        findT j = do
            k <- MV.unsafeRead as j
            if f k piv then return j else findT (j-1)

type IndType = Int

quicksort :: VUM.STVector s Int -> IndType -> IndType -> ST s ()
quicksort work iStart iEnd
    | iEnd - iStart <= 1 = return ()
    | otherwise =
        do
        pivot <- VUM.unsafeRead work ((iEnd + iStart) `shiftR` 1)
        med <- divide pivot iStart (iEnd - 1)
        quicksort work iStart med
        quicksort work med iEnd
    where
    divide pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            lower <- shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
            higher <- shrinkHigher pivot lower iE'
            if lower >= higher
                then return lower
                else do
                swapWork lower higher
                divide pivot (lower + 1) (higher - 1)

    shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iS'
            if x >= pivot
                then
                return iS'
                else
                shrinkLower pivot (iS' + 1) iE'

    shrinkHigher pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iE'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iE'
            if x <= pivot
                then
                return iE'
                else
                shrinkHigher pivot iS' (iE' - 1)

    swapWork = VUM.unsafeSwap work

    cs = sort' $ V.map modT2 bv
    s = sum $ map count as

    modT2 = (mask .&.)
    count a = (t12 - t01) + (n - t23) where

      t12 = binarySearch cs $ t2 - a'
      t23 = binarySearch cs $ 3 * t - a'
      a' = modT2 a

type IndType = Int

quicksort :: VUM.STVector s Int -> IndType -> IndType -> ST s ()
quicksort work iStart iEnd
    | iEnd - iStart <= 1 = return ()
    | otherwise =
        do
        pivot <- VUM.unsafeRead work ((iEnd + iStart) `shiftR` 1)
        med <- divide pivot iStart (iEnd - 1)
        quicksort work iStart med
        quicksort work med iEnd
    where

        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            lower <- shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
            higher <- shrinkHigher pivot lower iE'
            if lower >= higher
                then return lower
                else do
                swapWork lower higher
                divide pivot (lower + 1) (higher - 1)

    shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iS'
            if x >= pivot
                then
                return iS'
                else
                shrinkLower pivot (iS' + 1) iE'

    shrinkHigher pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iE'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iE'
            if x <= pivot
                then
                return iE'
                else
                shrinkHigher pivot iS' (iE' - 1)

    swapWork = VUM.unsafeSwap work

ts::Int->[Int]

st n as bs' t = if even$ sum $ map (f n v t) as then 0 else t

bmod:: [Int]->V.Vector Int
bmod bs = runST $ do
  v <- V.unsafeThaw $ V.fromList bs
  sortv (<) v 0 (MV.length v - 1)
  V.unsafeFreeze v

f::Int->V.Vector Int->Int->Int->Int
f n bs t a' = b2 - b1 + b4 - b3
  where

    b1 = bsearch (\i-> (bs V.! i) < (t-a)) (-1,n)

    | True = bsearch f (a,m)
    where m = (a + (b-a)`div`2)
--
{-# INLINE sortv #-}
sortv :: (a->a->Bool) -> MV.STVector s a -> Int -> Int -> ST s ()
sortv f as b e = do
        l <- MV.unsafeRead as b
        r <- MV.unsafeRead as e
        p <- findP l (b+1) e
        case p of
            Nothing -> return ()
            Just piv -> do
                k <- partv f as piv b e
                sortv f as b (k-1)
                sortv f as k e
    where
        findP a i e
            | i > e = return Nothing
            | True = do
                k <- MV.unsafeRead as i
                case (f a k, f k a) of
                    (True, _) -> return $ Just k
                    (_, True) -> return $ Just a
                    _ -> findP a (i+1) e

partv :: (a->a->Bool) -> MV.STVector s a -> a -> Int -> Int -> ST s Int
partv f as piv b e = do
    MV.unsafeSwap as b e
    l <- findF b
    r <- findT e
    if l <= r then partv f as piv l r
              else return l
    where
        findF i = do
            k <- MV.unsafeRead as i
            if f k piv then findF (i+1) else return i
        findT j = do
            k <- MV.unsafeRead as j
            if f k piv then return j else findT (j-1)

marge :: Ord a => VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> ST s ()
marge u v ret
  | VM.null u = VM.copy ret v
  | VM.null v = VM.copy ret u
  | otherwise = do
        x <- VM.read u 0
        y <- VM.read v 0
        if x > y then marge v u ret else do
            VM.write ret 0 x
            marge (VM.tail u) v (VM.tail ret)

    marge x y res
    V.freeze res

msort :: Ord a => V.Vector a -> V.Vector a
msort v = runST $ do
    v' <- V.thaw v
    work <- VM.new $ VM.length v'
    msort_ v' work
    V.unsafeFreeze v'

msort_ :: Ord a => VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> ST s ()
msort_ v work
  | VM.length v <= 1 = return ()
  | otherwise        = do
        VM.copy lwork lv
        VM.copy rwork rv
        msort_ lwork lv
        msort_ rwork rv
        marge lwork rwork v
        where
            toHalf vm = VM.splitAt (VM.length vm `div` 2) vm
            (lv, rv) = toHalf v
            (lwork, rwork) = toHalf work

st::Int->[Int]->[Int]->Int->Int
st n as bs' k = if even$ sum $ map (\a->f n v k2 (a .&. km)) as then 0 else k2
  where
    k2 = unsafeShiftL 1 k
    km = (unsafeShiftL 1 (k+1)) - 1
    !v = bmod $ map (\b->b .&. km) bs'

bmod:: [Int]->V.Vector Int
bmod bs = runST $ do
  v <- V.thaw $ V.fromList bs
  sortv v 0 (MV.length v - 1)
  V.unsafeFreeze v
--
f::Int->V.Vector Int->Int->Int->Int
f n bs t a = b2 - b1 + n - b3
  where
    b1 = ubound bs (t-1-a) (-1,n)
    b2 = ubound bs ((unsafeShiftL t 1)-1-a) (-1,n)
    b3 = ubound bs ((unsafeShiftL t 2)-1-a) (-1,n)
--    b4 = ubound bs (4*t-1-a) (-1,n)

ubound v k (a,b)
    | a+1 == b = b
    | V.unsafeIndex v m <= k = ubound v k (m,b)
    | True = ubound v k (a,m)
    where m = unsafeShiftR (a+b) 1
--
{-# INLINE sortv #-}
sortv :: MV.STVector s Int -> Int -> Int -> ST s ()
sortv as b e = do
        l <- MV.unsafeRead as b
        r <- MV.unsafeRead as e
        p <- findP l (b+1) e
        case p of
            Nothing -> return ()
            Just piv -> do
                k <- partv as piv b e
                sortv as b (k-1)
                sortv as k e
    where
        findP a i e
            | i > e = return Nothing
            | True = do
                k <- MV.unsafeRead as i
                case (a < k, k < a) of
                    (True, _) -> return $ Just k
                    (_, True) -> return $ Just a
                    _ -> findP a (i+1) e

partv :: MV.STVector s Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> ST s Int
partv as piv b e = do
    MV.unsafeSwap as b e
    l <- findF b
    r <- findT e

        findT j = do

ts::Int->[Int]
ts t
  | t==1 = [1]
  | True = t:(ts $ t`div`2)

st::V.Vector Int->Int->[Int]->[Int]->Int->Int
st v' n as bs' t = if even$ sum $ map (f n v t) as then 0 else t
  where v = bmod v' (t*2) bs'

bmod::V.Vector Int -> Int -> [Int]->V.Vector Int
bmod v' t bs = runST $ do
  v <- V.unsafeThaw v'
  forM_ (zip [0..] bs) $ \(i,b) -> MV.unsafeWrite v i (b`mod`t)
  sortv (<) v 0 (V.length v' - 1)
  V.unsafeFreeze v
--
f::Int->V.Vector Int->Int->Int->Int
f n bs t a' = b2 - b1 + b4 - b3
  where
    a = a' `mod` (t*2)
    b1 = bsearch (\i-> (bs V.! i) < (t-a)) (-1,n)
    b2 = bsearch (\i-> (bs V.! i) < (2*t-a)) (-1,n)
    b3 = bsearch (\i-> (bs V.! i) < (3*t-a)) (-1,n)
    b4 = bsearch (\i-> (bs V.! i) < (4*t-a)) (-1,n)

bsearch f (a,b)
    | a+1 == b = a
    | f m  = bsearch f (m,b)
    | True = bsearch f (a,m)
    where m = (a + (b-a)`div`2)

{-# INLINE sortv #-}
sortv :: (a->a->Bool) -> MV.STVector s a -> Int -> Int -> ST s ()
sortv f as b e = do
        l <- MV.unsafeRead as b
        r <- MV.unsafeRead as e
        p <- findP l (b+1) e
        case p of
            Nothing -> return ()
            Just piv -> do
                k <- partv f as piv b e
                sortv f as b (k-1)
                sortv f as k e
    where
        findP a i e
            | i > e = return Nothing
            | True = do
                k <- MV.unsafeRead as i
                case (f a k, f k a) of
                    (True, _) -> return $ Just k
                    (_, True) -> return $ Just a
                    _ -> findP a (i+1) e

partv :: (a->a->Bool) -> MV.STVector s a -> a -> Int -> Int -> ST s Int
partv f as piv b e = do
    MV.unsafeSwap as b e
    l <- findF b
    r <- findT e
    if l <= r then partv f as piv l r
              else return l
    where
        findF i = do
            k <- MV.unsafeRead as i
            if f k piv then findF (i+1) else return i
        findT j = do
            k <- MV.unsafeRead as j
            if f k piv then return j else findT (j-1)

binarySearch :: (Int -> Word) -> (Int, Int) -> Word -> Int
binarySearch xs (al, ar) y = go al ar where
    go l r
        | l == r = l
        | x < y = go (m + 1) r
        | x >= y = go l m
        where m = (r + l) `shiftR` 1
              x = xs m

            then upperBoundImpl key (mid, r) f
            else upperBoundImpl key (l, mid) f

-- https://github.com/as-capabl/haskell-qsort-pfm/blob/master/src/UV.hs
type IndType = Int

quicksort :: VUM.STVector s Int -> IndType -> IndType -> ST s ()
quicksort work iStart iEnd
    | iEnd - iStart <= 1 = return ()
    | otherwise =
        do
        pivot <- VUM.unsafeRead work ((iEnd + iStart) `shiftR` 1)
        med <- divide pivot iStart (iEnd - 1)
        quicksort work iStart med
        quicksort work med iEnd
    where
    divide pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            lower <- shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
            higher <- shrinkHigher pivot lower iE'
            if lower >= higher
                then return lower
                else do
                swapWork lower higher
                divide pivot (lower + 1) (higher - 1)

    shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iS'
            if x >= pivot
                then
                return iS'
                else
                shrinkLower pivot (iS' + 1) iE'

    shrinkHigher pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iE'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iE'
            if x <= pivot
                then
                return iE'
                else
                shrinkHigher pivot iS' (iE' - 1)

    swapWork = VUM.unsafeSwap work

lowerBound :: (Ord e, Eq e, VU.Unbox e) => VU.Vector e -> e -> Int
lowerBound arr x = lowerBound' 0 (n-1)
  where
    n = VU.length arr
    lowerBound' l r
      | arr VU.! (n-1) < x = n
      | r - l <= 1 = if arr VU.! l < x then r else l
      | otherwise = let m = div (l+r) 2 in
                      if arr VU.! m < x then
                        lowerBound' m r
                      else
                        lowerBound' l m

-- https://github.com/as-capabl/haskell-qsort-pfm/blob/master/src/UV.hs
type IndType = Int

quicksort :: VUM.STVector s Int -> IndType -> IndType -> ST s ()
quicksort work iStart iEnd
    | iEnd - iStart <= 1 = return ()
    | otherwise =
        do
        pivot <- VUM.unsafeRead work ((iEnd + iStart) `shiftR` 1)
        med <- divide pivot iStart (iEnd - 1)
        quicksort work iStart med
        quicksort work med iEnd
    where
    divide pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            lower <- shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
            higher <- shrinkHigher pivot lower iE'
            if lower >= higher
                then do
                return lower
                else do
                swapWork lower higher
                divide pivot (lower + 1) (higher - 1)

    shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iS'
            if x >= pivot
                then
                return iS'
                else
                shrinkLower pivot (iS' + 1) iE'

    shrinkHigher pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iE'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iE'
            if x <= pivot
                then
                return iE'
                else
                shrinkHigher pivot iS' (iE' - 1)

    swapWork i j = VUM.unsafeSwap work i j

marge :: Ord a => VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> ST s ()
marge u v ret
  | VM.null u = VM.copy ret v
  | VM.null v = VM.copy ret u
  | otherwise = do
        x <- VM.read u 0
        y <- VM.read v 0
        if x > y then marge v u ret else do
            VM.write ret 0 x
            marge (VM.tail u) v (VM.tail ret)

    V.freeze res

msort :: Ord a => V.Vector a -> V.Vector a

    work <- VM.new $ VM.length v'
    msort_ v' work
    V.unsafeFreeze v'

msort_ :: Ord a => VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> ST s ()
msort_ v work
  | VM.length v <= 1 = return ()
  | otherwise        = do
        VM.copy lwork lv
        VM.copy rwork rv
        msort_ lwork lv
        msort_ rwork rv
        marge lwork rwork v

-- keyより大きいところのインデックス
-- 広義単調増加関数であること
upperBoundImpl :: Word -> (Int, Int) -> (Int -> Word) -> Int
upperBoundImpl key (l, r) f =
    let mid = (l + r) `div` 2
    in  if r - l <= 1 then r else
        if f mid <= key
            then upperBoundImpl key (mid, r) f
            else upperBoundImpl key (l, mid) f

upperBound :: Word -> (Int, Int) -> (Int -> Word) -> Int
upperBound key (l, r) f = upperBoundImpl key (l - 1, r) f'
    where f' i = if i < l then minBound :: Word else f i

xorOnFigure :: Int -> Int -> (Int -> Word) -> Word

    let notCarriers = upperBound (bit (k + 1) - 1) (0, n) sorted
        i = upperBound (bit k - 1) (0, notCarriers) sorted
        j = upperBound (bit (k + 1) + bit k - 1) (notCarriers, n) sorted
        cnt = (notCarriers - i) + (n - j)
    in  if odd cnt then bit k else 0

eachFigure :: Int -> [Word] -> [Word] -> Word

upperBoundImpl :: Int -> (Int, Int) -> VU.Vector Int -> Int
upperBoundImpl key (l, r) f =
    let mid = (l + r) `unsafeShiftR` 1
    in  if r - l <= 1 then r else
        if f `VU.unsafeIndex` mid <= key
            then upperBoundImpl key (mid, r) f
            else upperBoundImpl key (l, mid) f

upperBound :: Int -> (Int, Int) -> VU.Vector Int -> Int

unsafeBit = (1 `unsafeShiftL`)

xorOnFigure :: VU.Vector Int -> Int -> Int -> Int
xorOnFigure sorted k a =
    let n = VU.length sorted
        notCarriers = upperBound (unsafeBit (k + 1) - 1 - a) (0, n) sorted
        i = upperBound (unsafeBit k - 1 - a) (0, n) sorted
        j = upperBound (unsafeBit k * 3 - 1 - a) (0, n) sorted
    in  (notCarriers - i) + (n - j)

eachFigure' :: [Int] -> [Int] -> Int -> Int
eachFigure' as bs k =
    let v = sort' $ VU.map (.&. (unsafeBit (k + 1) - 1)) $ VU.fromList bs
    in  if odd $ sum $ map (xorOnFigure v k) $ (.&. (unsafeBit (k + 1) - 1)) <$> as
        then unsafeBit k
        else 0
        
sort' :: VU.Vector Int -> VU.Vector Int

-- https://github.com/as-capabl/haskell-qsort-pfm/blob/master/src/UV.hs
type IndType = Int

quicksort :: VUM.STVector s Int -> IndType -> IndType -> ST s ()
quicksort work iStart iEnd
    | iEnd - iStart <= 1 = return ()
    | otherwise =
        do
        pivot <- VUM.unsafeRead work ((iEnd + iStart) `shiftR` 1)
        med <- divide pivot iStart (iEnd - 1)
        quicksort work iStart med
        quicksort work med iEnd
    where
    divide pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            lower <- shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
            higher <- shrinkHigher pivot lower iE'
            if lower >= higher
                then return lower
                else do
                swapWork lower higher
                divide pivot (lower + 1) (higher - 1)

    shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iS'
            if x >= pivot
                then
                return iS'
                else
                shrinkLower pivot (iS' + 1) iE'

    shrinkHigher pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iE'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iE'
            if x <= pivot
                then
                return iE'
                else
                shrinkHigher pivot iS' (iE' - 1)

    swapWork = VUM.unsafeSwap work

{-# LANGUAGE BangPatterns #-}
import Data.Bits ((.&.))

import Control.Monad

main=do
  n<-readLn::IO Int
  as<-unfoldr (B.readInt.B.dropWhile(==' '))<$>B.getLine::IO[Int]
  bs<-unfoldr (B.readInt.B.dropWhile(==' '))<$>B.getLine::IO[Int]
  let !buf = V.replicate n 0
  --
  print.sum.map (st buf n as bs) $ ts (2^28)
--
ts::Int->[Int]
ts t
  | t==1 = [1]
  | True = t:(ts $ t`div`2)

st::V.Vector Int->Int->[Int]->[Int]->Int->Int
st v' n as bs' t = if even$ sum $ map (f n v t) as then 0 else t
  where !v = bmod v' (t*2-1) bs'

bmod::V.Vector Int -> Int -> [Int]->V.Vector Int
bmod v' tm bs = runST $ do
  v <- V.unsafeThaw v'
  forM_ (zip [0..] bs) $ \(i,b) -> MV.unsafeWrite v i (b .&. tm)
  sortv (<) v 0 (V.length v' - 1)
  V.unsafeFreeze v
--
f::Int->V.Vector Int->Int->Int->Int
f n bs t a' = b2 - b1 + b4 - b3
  where
    !a = a' `mod` (t*2)
    b1 = bsearch (\i-> (bs V.! i) < (t-a)) (-1,n)
    b2 = bsearch (\i-> (bs V.! i) < (2*t-a)) (-1,n)
    b3 = bsearch (\i-> (bs V.! i) < (3*t-a)) (-1,n)
    b4 = bsearch (\i-> (bs V.! i) < (4*t-a)) (-1,n)

bsearch f (a,b)
    | a+1 == b = a
    | f m  = bsearch f (m,b)
    | True = bsearch f (a,m)
    where m = (a + (b-a)`div`2)
--
{-# INLINE sortv #-}
sortv :: (a->a->Bool) -> MV.STVector s a -> Int -> Int -> ST s ()
sortv f as b e = do
        l <- MV.unsafeRead as b
        r <- MV.unsafeRead as e
        p <- findP l (b+1) e
        case p of
            Nothing -> return ()
            Just piv -> do
                k <- partv f as piv b e
                sortv f as b (k-1)
                sortv f as k e
    where
        findP a i e
            | i > e = return Nothing
            | True = do
                k <- MV.unsafeRead as i
                case (f a k, f k a) of
                    (True, _) -> return $ Just k
                    (_, True) -> return $ Just a
                    _ -> findP a (i+1) e

partv :: (a->a->Bool) -> MV.STVector s a -> a -> Int -> Int -> ST s Int
partv f as piv b e = do
    MV.unsafeSwap as b e
    l <- findF b
    r <- findT e
    if l <= r then partv f as piv l r
              else return l
    where
        findF i = do
            k <- MV.unsafeRead as i
            if f k piv then findF (i+1) else return i
        findT j = do
            k <- MV.unsafeRead as j
            if f k piv then return j else findT (j-1)

-- https://github.com/as-capabl/haskell-qsort-pfm/blob/master/src/UV.hs
type IndType = Int

quicksort :: VUM.STVector s Int -> IndType -> IndType -> ST s ()
quicksort work iStart iEnd
    | iEnd - iStart <= 1 = return ()
    | otherwise =
        do
        pivot <- VUM.unsafeRead work ((iEnd + iStart) `shiftR` 1)
        med <- divide pivot iStart (iEnd - 1)
        quicksort work iStart med
        quicksort work med iEnd
    where
    divide pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            lower <- shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
            higher <- shrinkHigher pivot lower iE'
            if lower >= higher
                then do
                return lower
                else do
                swapWork lower higher
                divide pivot (lower + 1) (higher - 1)

    shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iS'
            if x >= pivot
                then
                return iS'
                else
                shrinkLower pivot (iS' + 1) iE'

    shrinkHigher pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iE'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iE'
            if x <= pivot
                then
                return iE'
                else
                shrinkHigher pivot iS' (iE' - 1)

    swapWork i j = VUM.unsafeSwap work i j

upperBoundImpl :: Word -> (Int, Int) -> (Int -> Word) -> Int
upperBoundImpl key (l, r) f =
    let mid = (l + r) `div` 2
    in  if r - l <= 1 then r else
        if f mid <= key
            then upperBoundImpl key (mid, r) f
            else upperBoundImpl key (l, mid) f

upperBound :: Word -> (Int, Int) -> (Int -> Word) -> Int

    where f' i = if i < l then minBound :: Word else f i

        j = upperBound (bit (k + 1) + bit k - 1) (notCarriers, n) sorted
        cnt = (notCarriers - i) + (n - j)
    in  if odd cnt then bit k else 0

import Data.Bits ((.&.),unsafeShiftL, unsafeShiftR)

import Control.Monad

main=do

  as<-unfoldr (B.readInt.B.dropWhile(==' '))<$>B.getLine::IO[Int]
  bs<-unfoldr (B.readInt.B.dropWhile(==' '))<$>B.getLine::IO[Int]
  --
  print.sum.map (st n as bs) $ [0..28]
--

st::Int->[Int]->[Int]->Int->Int
st n as bs' k = if even$ sum $ map (\a->f n v k2 (a .&. km)) as then 0 else k2
  where
    k2 = unsafeShiftL 1 k
    km = (unsafeShiftL 1 (k+1)) - 1
    !v = bmod $ map (\b->b .&. km) bs'

bmod:: [Int]->V.Vector Int
bmod bs = runST $ do
  v <- V.thaw $ V.fromList bs
  sortv v 0 (MV.length v - 1)
  V.unsafeFreeze v
--
f::Int->V.Vector Int->Int->Int->Int
f n bs t a = b2 - b1 + n - b3
  where
    b1 = ubound bs (t-1-a) (-1,n)
    b2 = ubound bs ((unsafeShiftL t 1)-1-a) (-1,n)
    b3 = ubound bs (t*3-1-a) (-1,n)
--    b4 = ubound bs (4*t-1-a) (-1,n)

ubound v k (a,b)
    | a+1 == b = b
    | V.unsafeIndex v m <= k = ubound v k (m,b)
    | True = ubound v k (a,m)
    where m = unsafeShiftR (a+b) 1
--
{-# INLINE sortv #-}
sortv :: MV.STVector s Int -> Int -> Int -> ST s ()
sortv as b e = do
        l <- MV.unsafeRead as b
        r <- MV.unsafeRead as e
        p <- findP l (b+1) e
        case p of
            Nothing -> return ()
            Just piv -> do
                k <- partv as piv b e
                sortv as b (k-1)
                sortv as k e
    where
        findP a i e
            | i > e = return Nothing
            | True = do
                k <- MV.unsafeRead as i
                case (a < k, k < a) of
                    (True, _) -> return $ Just k
                    (_, True) -> return $ Just a
                    _ -> findP a (i+1) e

partv :: MV.STVector s Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> ST s Int
partv as piv b e = do
    MV.unsafeSwap as b e
    l <- findF b
    r <- findT e
    if l <= r then partv as piv l r
              else return l
    where
        findF i = do
            k <- MV.unsafeRead as i
            if k < piv then findF (i+1) else return i
        findT j = do
            k <- MV.unsafeRead as j
            if k < piv then return j else findT (j-1)

            if x <= pivot
                then

marge :: Ord a => VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> ST s ()
marge u v ret
  | VM.null u = VM.copy ret v
  | VM.null v = VM.copy ret u
  | otherwise = do
        x <- VM.read u 0
        y <- VM.read v 0
        if x > y then marge v u ret else do
            VM.write ret 0 x
            marge (VM.tail u) v (VM.tail ret)

testMarge :: V.Vector Int

    res <- VM.new 4
    marge x y res
    V.freeze res

msort :: Ord a => V.Vector a -> V.Vector a
msort v = runST $ do
    v' <- V.thaw v
    work <- VM.new $ VM.length v'
    msort_ v' work
    V.unsafeFreeze v'

msort_ :: Ord a => VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> ST s ()
msort_ v work
  | VM.length v <= 1 = return ()
  | otherwise        = do
        VM.copy lwork lv
        VM.copy rwork rv
        msort_ lwork lv
        msort_ rwork rv
        marge lwork rwork v
        where
            toHalf vm = VM.splitAt (VM.length vm `div` 2) vm
            (lv, rv) = toHalf v
            (lwork, rwork) = toHalf work

binarySearch :: (Int -> Word) -> (Int, Int) -> Word -> Int
binarySearch xs (al, ar) y = go al ar where
    go l r
        | l == r = l
        | x < y = go (m + 1) r
        | x >= y = go l m
        where m = (r + l) `shiftR` 1
              x = xs m

upperBoundImpl key (l, r) f =
    let mid = (l + r) `unsafeShiftR` 1
    in  if r - l <= 1 then r else
        if f `VU.unsafeIndex` mid <= key
            then upperBoundImpl key (mid, r) f
            else upperBoundImpl key (l, mid) f

upperBound :: Int -> (Int, Int) -> VU.Vector Int -> Int
upperBound key (l, r) = upperBoundImpl key (l - 1, r)

-- https://github.com/as-capabl/haskell-qsort-pfm/blob/master/src/UV.hs
type IndType = Int

quicksort :: VUM.STVector s Int -> IndType -> IndType -> ST s ()
quicksort work iStart iEnd
    | iEnd - iStart <= 1 = return ()
    | otherwise =
        do
        pivot <- VUM.unsafeRead work ((iEnd + iStart) `shiftR` 1)
        med <- divide pivot iStart (iEnd - 1)
        quicksort work iStart med
        quicksort work med iEnd
    where
    divide pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            lower <- shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
            higher <- shrinkHigher pivot lower iE'
            if lower >= higher
                then return lower
                else do
                swapWork lower higher
                divide pivot (lower + 1) (higher - 1)

    shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iS'
            if x >= pivot
                then
                return iS'
                else
                shrinkLower pivot (iS' + 1) iE'

    shrinkHigher pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iE'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iE'
            if x <= pivot
                then
                return iE'
                else
                shrinkHigher pivot iS' (iE' - 1)

    swapWork = VUM.unsafeSwap work

--
ts::Int->[Int]
ts t
  | t==1 = [1]
  | True = t:(ts $ t`div`2)

st::V.Vector Int->Int->[Int]->[Int]->Int->Int
st v' n as bs' t = if even$ sum $ map (f n v t) as then 0 else t
  where !v = bmod v' (t*2-1) bs'

bmod::V.Vector Int -> Int -> [Int]->V.Vector Int
bmod v' tm bs = runST $ do
  v <- V.unsafeThaw v'
  forM_ (zip [0..] bs) $ \(i,b) -> MV.unsafeWrite v i (b .&. tm)
  sortv (<) v 0 (V.length v' - 1)
  V.unsafeFreeze v
--
f::Int->V.Vector Int->Int->Int->Int
f n bs t a' = b2 - b1 + b4 - b3
  where
    !a = a' `mod` (t*2)
    b1 = bsearch (\i-> (bs V.! i) < (t-a)) (-1,n)
    b2 = bsearch (\i-> (bs V.! i) < (2*t-a)) (b1,n)
    b3 = bsearch (\i-> (bs V.! i) < (3*t-a)) (b2,n)
    b4 = bsearch (\i-> (bs V.! i) < (4*t-a)) (b3,n)

bsearch f (a,b)
    | a+1 == b = a
    | f m  = bsearch f (m,b)
    | True = bsearch f (a,m)
    where m = (a + (b-a)`div`2)
--
{-# INLINE sortv #-}
sortv :: (a->a->Bool) -> MV.STVector s a -> Int -> Int -> ST s ()
sortv f as b e = do
        l <- MV.unsafeRead as b
        r <- MV.unsafeRead as e
        p <- findP l (b+1) e
        case p of
            Nothing -> return ()
            Just piv -> do
                k <- partv f as piv b e
                sortv f as b (k-1)
                sortv f as k e
    where
        findP a i e
            | i > e = return Nothing
            | True = do
                k <- MV.unsafeRead as i
                case (f a k, f k a) of
                    (True, _) -> return $ Just k
                    (_, True) -> return $ Just a
                    _ -> findP a (i+1) e

partv :: (a->a->Bool) -> MV.STVector s a -> a -> Int -> Int -> ST s Int
partv f as piv b e = do
    MV.unsafeSwap as b e
    l <- findF b
    r <- findT e
    if l <= r then partv f as piv l r
              else return l
    where
        findF i = do
            k <- MV.unsafeRead as i
            if f k piv then findF (i+1) else return i
        findT j = do
            k <- MV.unsafeRead as j
            if f k piv then return j else findT (j-1)

main :: IO ()

    ys <- U.unfoldrN n (runParser int) <$> C.getLine

solve :: Int -> U.Vector Int -> U.Vector Int -> Int
solve n xs ys = U.foldl' (.|.) 0
    $ U.generate 29 (\i -> shiftL (calc i .&. 1) i)
  where
    calc 0 =
        let xs1 = U.length $ U.filter (`testBit` 0) xs
            xs0 = n - xs1
            ys1 = U.length $ U.filter (`testBit` 0) ys
            ys0 = n - ys1
        in xs1 * ys0 + xs0 * ys1
    calc k =
        let !mask = bit k - 1
            !ys0 = radixSort64 . U.map (.&. mask) $ U.filter (not.(`testBit` k)) ys
            !ys1 = radixSort64 . U.map (.&. mask) $ U.filter (`testBit` k) ys
            !num0 = U.length ys0
            !num1 = U.length ys1
            f x | testBit x k = k0 + num1 - k1
                | otherwise = k1 + num0 - k0
              where
                !x' = x .&. mask
                !y' = mask - x'
                !k0 = lowerBound 0 num0 ((y' <).U.unsafeIndex ys0)
                !k1 = lowerBound 0 num1 ((y' <).U.unsafeIndex ys1)
        in U.sum $ U.map f xs


testBit :: Int -> Int -> Bool
testBit x i = unsafeShiftRL x i .&. 1 == 1

radixSort64 :: U.Vector Int -> U.Vector Int
radixSort64 v = F.foldl' step v [0, 16, 32, 48]
  where
    mask k x = fromIntegral $ unsafeShiftRL x k .&. 0xffff
    step v k = U.create $ do
        pref <- U.unsafeThaw
            . U.prescanl' (+) 0
            . U.unsafeAccumulate (+) (U.replicate 0x10000 0)
            $ U.map (flip (,) 1 . mask k) v
        res <- UM.unsafeNew $ U.length v
        U.forM_ v $ \x -> do
            let !masked = mask k x
            i <- UM.unsafeRead pref masked
            UM.unsafeWrite pref masked $ i + 1
            UM.unsafeWrite res i x
        return res
{-# INLINE radixSort64 #-}

rep :: (Monad m) => Int -> (Int -> m ()) -> m ()
rep n = flip MS.mapM_ (stream 0 n)
{-# INLINE rep #-}
rev :: (Monad m) => Int -> (Int -> m ()) -> m ()
rev !n = flip MS.mapM_ (streamR 0 n)
{-# INLINE rev #-}
stream :: (Monad m) => Int -> Int -> MS.Stream m Int
stream !l !r = MS.Stream step l where { step x | x < r = return $ MS.Yield x (x + 1) | otherwise = return MS.Done; {-# INLINE [0] step #-}}
{-# INLINE [1] stream #-}
streamR :: (Monad m) => Int -> Int -> MS.Stream m Int
streamR !l !r = MS.Stream step (r - 1) where { step x | x >= l = return $ MS.Yield x (x - 1) | otherwise = return MS.Done; {-# INLINE [0] step #-}}
{-# INLINE [1] streamR #-}
stream' :: (Monad m) => Int -> Int -> Int -> MS.Stream m Int
stream' !l !r !d = MS.Stream step l where { step x | x < r = return $ MS.Yield x (x + d) | otherwise = return MS.Done; {-# INLINE [0] step #-}}
{-# INLINE [1] stream' #-}
infixl 8 `shiftRL`, `unsafeShiftRL`
shiftRL :: Int -> Int -> Int
shiftRL = unsafeShiftRL
{-# INLINE shiftRL #-}
unsafeShiftRL :: Int -> Int -> Int
unsafeShiftRL (I# x#) (I# i#) = I# (uncheckedIShiftRL# x# i#)
{-# INLINE unsafeShiftRL #-}
type Parser a = StateT C.ByteString Maybe a
runParser :: Parser a -> C.ByteString -> Maybe (a, C.ByteString)
runParser = runStateT
{-# INLINE runParser #-}
int :: Parser Int
int = coerce $ C.readInt . C.dropWhile isSpace
{-# INLINE int #-}
int1 :: Parser Int
int1 = fmap (subtract 1) int
{-# INLINE int1 #-}
char :: Parser Char
char = coerce C.uncons
{-# INLINE char #-}
byte :: Parser Word8
byte = coerce B.uncons
{-# INLINE byte #-}
skipSpaces :: Parser ()
skipSpaces = modify' (C.dropWhile isSpace)
{-# INLINE skipSpaces #-}
lowerBoundM :: (Monad m) => Int -> Int -> (Int -> m Bool) -> m Int
lowerBoundM low high p = go low high where { go !low !high | high <= low = return high | otherwise = p mid >>= bool (go (mid + 1) high) (go low mid) where { mid = low + unsafeShiftRL (high - low) 1}}
{-# INLINE lowerBoundM #-}
upperBoundM :: (Monad m) => Int -> Int -> (Int -> m Bool) -> m Int
upperBoundM low high p = do { flg <- p high; if flg then return high else subtract 1 <$!> lowerBoundM low high (fmap not . p)}
{-# INLINE upperBoundM #-}
lowerBound :: Int -> Int -> (Int -> Bool) -> Int
lowerBound low high p = runIdentity (lowerBoundM low high (return . p))
{-# INLINE lowerBound #-}
upperBound :: Int -> Int -> (Int -> Bool) -> Int
upperBound low high p = runIdentity (upperBoundM low high (return . p))
{-# INLINE upperBound #-}

{-# INLINE bucketsortDescBy #-}

marge :: Ord a => VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> ST s ()
marge u v ret
  | VM.null u = VM.copy ret v
  | VM.null v = VM.copy ret u
  | otherwise = do
        x <- VM.read u 0
        y <- VM.read v 0
        if x > y then marge v u ret else do
            VM.write ret 0 x
            marge (VM.tail u) v (VM.tail ret)

testMarge :: V.Vector Int

    y <- V.thaw $ V.fromList ([2, 3] :: [Int])
    res <- VM.new 4
    marge x y res
    V.freeze res

msort :: Ord a => V.Vector a -> V.Vector a
msort v = runST $ do
    v' <- V.thaw v
    work <- VM.new $ VM.length v'
    msort_ v' work
    V.unsafeFreeze v'

msort_ :: Ord a => VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> ST s ()
msort_ v work
  | VM.length v <= 1 = return ()
  | otherwise        = do
        VM.copy lwork lv
        VM.copy rwork rv
        msort_ lwork lv
        msort_ rwork rv
        marge lwork rwork v
        where
            toHalf vm = VM.splitAt (VM.length vm `div` 2) vm
            (lv, rv) = toHalf v
            (lwork, rwork) = toHalf work

binarySearch :: VU.Vector Int -> Int -> Int
binarySearch xs y = go 0 $ VU.length xs where
    go l r
        | l == r = l
        | x < y = go (m + 1) r
        | x >= y = go l m
        where m = (r + l) `shiftR` 1
              x = xs `VU.unsafeIndex` m

upperBoundImpl key (l, r) f =
    let mid = (l + r) `unsafeShiftR` 1
    in  if r - l <= 1 then r else
        if f `VU.unsafeIndex` mid <= key
            then upperBoundImpl key (mid, r) f
            else upperBoundImpl key (l, mid) f

upperBound :: Int -> (Int, Int) -> VU.Vector Int -> Int
upperBound key (l, r) = upperBoundImpl key (l - 1, r)

unsafeBit = (1 `unsafeShiftL`)

xorOnFigure :: VU.Vector Int -> Int -> Int -> Int
xorOnFigure sorted k a =
    let n = VU.length sorted
        --notCarriers = upperBound (unsafeBit (k + 1) - 1 - a) (0, n) sorted
        --i = upperBound (unsafeBit k - 1 - a) (0, n) sorted
        --j = upperBound (unsafeBit k * 3 - 1 - a) (0, n) sorted
        notCarriers = binarySearch sorted $ unsafeBit (k + 1) - a
        i = binarySearch sorted $ unsafeBit k - a
        j = binarySearch sorted $ unsafeBit (k + 1) + unsafeBit k - a
    in  (notCarriers - i) + (n - j)

eachFigure' :: [Int] -> [Int] -> Int -> Int
eachFigure' as bs k =
    let v = sort' $ VU.map (.&. (unsafeBit (k + 1) - 1)) $ VU.fromList bs
    in  if odd $ sum $ map (xorOnFigure v k) $ (.&. (unsafeBit (k + 1) - 1)) <$> as
        then unsafeBit k
        else 0

-- https://github.com/as-capabl/haskell-qsort-pfm/blob/master/src/UV.hs
type IndType = Int

quicksort :: VUM.STVector s Int -> IndType -> IndType -> ST s ()
quicksort work iStart iEnd
    | iEnd - iStart <= 1 = return ()
    | otherwise =
        do
        pivot <- VUM.unsafeRead work ((iEnd + iStart) `shiftR` 1)
        med <- divide pivot iStart (iEnd - 1)
        quicksort work iStart med
        quicksort work med iEnd
    where
    divide pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            lower <- shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
            higher <- shrinkHigher pivot lower iE'
            if lower >= higher
                then return lower
                else do
                swapWork lower higher
                divide pivot (lower + 1) (higher - 1)

    shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iS'
            if x >= pivot
                then
                return iS'
                else
                shrinkLower pivot (iS' + 1) iE'

    shrinkHigher pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iE'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iE'
            if x <= pivot
                then
                return iE'
                else
                shrinkHigher pivot iS' (iE' - 1)

    swapWork = VUM.unsafeSwap work

bmod::Int -> V.Vector Int -> V.Vector Int
bmod t bs = runST $ do
  v <- V.unsafeThaw bs :: ST s (MV.STVector s Int)
  sortv (\a b -> ((a`mod`t)<(b`mod`t))) v 0 (V.length bs - 1)
  V.unsafeFreeze v

{-# INLINE sortv #-}
sortv :: (Int->Int->Bool) -> MV.STVector s Int -> Int -> Int -> ST s ()
sortv f as b e = do
        l <- MV.unsafeRead as b
        r <- MV.unsafeRead as e
        p <- findP l (b+1) e
        case p of
            Nothing -> return ()
            Just piv -> do
                k <- partv f as piv b e
                sortv f as b (k-1)
                sortv f as k e
    where
        findP a i e
            | i > e = return Nothing
            | True = do
                k <- MV.unsafeRead as i
                case (f a k, f k a) of
                    (True, _) -> return $ Just k
                    (_, True) -> return $ Just a
                    _ -> findP a (i+1) e

partv :: (Int->Int->Bool) -> MV.STVector s Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> ST s Int
partv f as piv b e = do
    MV.unsafeSwap as b e
    l <- findF b
    r <- findT e
    if l <= r then partv f as piv l r
              else return l
    where
        findF i = do
            k <- MV.unsafeRead as i
            if f k piv then findF (i+1) else return i
        findT j = do
            k <- MV.unsafeRead as j
            if f k piv then return j else findT (j-1)

-- keyより大きいところのインデックス
-- 広義単調増加関数であること
upperBoundImpl :: Word -> (Int, Int) -> (Int -> Word) -> Int
upperBoundImpl key (l, r) f =
    let mid = shiftR (l + r) 1
    in  if r - l <= 1 then r else
        upperBoundImpl key (if f mid <= key then (mid, r) else (l, mid)) f

upperBound :: Word -> (Int, Int) -> (Int -> Word) -> Int
upperBound key (l, r) f = upperBoundImpl key (l - 1, r) f'
    where f' i = if i < l then minBound :: Word else f i

xorOnFigure :: Int -> Int -> (Int -> Word) -> Word
xorOnFigure n k sorted =
    let notCarriers = upperBound (bit (k + 1) - 1) (0, n) sorted
        i = upperBound (bit k - 1) (0, notCarriers) sorted
        j = upperBound (bit (k + 1) + bit k - 1) (notCarriers, n) sorted
        cnt = (notCarriers - i) + (n - j)
    in  if odd cnt then bit k else 0

eachFigure :: Int -> [Word] -> [Word] -> Word
eachFigure k as sortedBs =
    let v = VU.fromList $ (.&. (bit (k + 1) - 1)) <$> sortedBs
        f a = xorOnFigure (length sortedBs) k $ (a +) . (v VU.!)
    in  foldr1 xor $ map f $ (.&. (bit (k + 1) - 1)) <$> as

build :: Int -> [Word] -> [[Word]]
build 29 _ = []
build k bs = sorted : build (k + 1) sorted
    where sorted = bucketsortBy (\w -> if testBit w k then 1 else 0) (0, 1) bs :: [Word]

-- https://github.com/as-capabl/haskell-qsort-pfm/blob/master/src/UV.hs
type IndType = Int

quicksort :: VUM.STVector s Int -> IndType -> IndType -> ST s ()
quicksort work iStart iEnd
    | iEnd - iStart <= 1 = return ()
    | otherwise =
        do
        pivot <- VUM.unsafeRead work ((iEnd + iStart) `shiftR` 1)
        med <- divide pivot iStart (iEnd - 1)
        quicksort work iStart med
        quicksort work med iEnd
    where
    divide pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            lower <- shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
            higher <- shrinkHigher pivot lower iE'
            if lower >= higher
                then return lower
                else do
                swapWork lower higher
                divide pivot (lower + 1) (higher - 1)

    shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iS'
            if x >= pivot
                then
                return iS'
                else
                shrinkLower pivot (iS' + 1) iE'

    shrinkHigher pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iE'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iE'
            if x <= pivot
                then
                return iE'
                else
                shrinkHigher pivot iS' (iE' - 1)

    swapWork = VUM.unsafeSwap work

lowerBound :: (Ord e, Eq e, VU.Unbox e) => VU.Vector e -> e -> Int
lowerBound arr x = lowerBound' 0 (n-1)
  where
    n = VU.length arr
    lowerBound' l r
      | arr VU.! (n-1) < x = n
      | r - l <= 1 = if arr VU.! l < x then r else l
      | otherwise = let m = div (l+r) 2 in
                      if arr VU.! m < x then
                        lowerBound' m r
                      else
                        lowerBound' l m

quickSortList :: (Ord a) => [a] -> [a]
quickSortList [] = []
quickSortList (x:xs) = quickSortList lt ++ [x] ++ quickSortList gt
  where
    lt = filter (<x) xs
    gt = filter (>=x) xs

--
ts::Int->[Int]
ts t
  | t==1 = [1]
  | True = t:(ts $ t`div`2)

st::V.Vector Int->Int->[Int]->[Int]->Int->Int
st v' n as bs' t = if even$ sum $ map (f n v t) as then 0 else t
  where !v = bmod v' (t*2) bs'

bmod::V.Vector Int -> Int -> [Int]->V.Vector Int
bmod v' t bs = runST $ do
  v <- V.unsafeThaw v'
  forM_ (zip [0..] bs) $ \(i,b) -> MV.unsafeWrite v i (b`mod`t)
  sortv (<) v 0 (V.length v' - 1)
  V.unsafeFreeze v
--
f::Int->V.Vector Int->Int->Int->Int
f n bs t a' = b2 - b1 + b4 - b3
  where
    !a = a' `mod` (t*2)
    b1 = bsearch (\i-> (bs V.! i) < (t-a)) (-1,n)
    b2 = bsearch (\i-> (bs V.! i) < (2*t-a)) (-1,n)
    b3 = bsearch (\i-> (bs V.! i) < (3*t-a)) (-1,n)
    b4 = bsearch (\i-> (bs V.! i) < (4*t-a)) (-1,n)

bsearch f (a,b)
    | a+1 == b = a
    | f m  = bsearch f (m,b)
    | True = bsearch f (a,m)
    where m = (a + (b-a)`div`2)
--
{-# INLINE sortv #-}
sortv :: (a->a->Bool) -> MV.STVector s a -> Int -> Int -> ST s ()
sortv f as b e = do
        l <- MV.unsafeRead as b
        r <- MV.unsafeRead as e
        p <- findP l (b+1) e
        case p of
            Nothing -> return ()
            Just piv -> do
                k <- partv f as piv b e
                sortv f as b (k-1)
                sortv f as k e
    where
        findP a i e
            | i > e = return Nothing
            | True = do
                k <- MV.unsafeRead as i
                case (f a k, f k a) of
                    (True, _) -> return $ Just k
                    (_, True) -> return $ Just a
                    _ -> findP a (i+1) e

partv :: (a->a->Bool) -> MV.STVector s a -> a -> Int -> Int -> ST s Int
partv f as piv b e = do
    MV.unsafeSwap as b e
    l <- findF b
    r <- findT e
    if l <= r then partv f as piv l r
              else return l
    where
        findF i = do
            k <- MV.unsafeRead as i
            if f k piv then findF (i+1) else return i
        findT j = do
            k <- MV.unsafeRead as j
            if f k piv then return j else findT (j-1)

type IndType = Int

quicksort :: VUM.STVector s Int -> IndType -> IndType -> ST s ()
quicksort work iStart iEnd
    | iEnd - iStart <= 1 = return ()
    | otherwise =
        do
        pivot <- VUM.unsafeRead work ((iEnd + iStart) `shiftR` 1)
        med <- divide pivot iStart (iEnd - 1)
        quicksort work iStart med
        quicksort work med iEnd
    where
    divide pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            lower <- shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
            higher <- shrinkHigher pivot lower iE'
            if lower >= higher
                then return lower
                else do
                swapWork lower higher
                divide pivot (lower + 1) (higher - 1)

    shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iS'
            if x >= pivot
                then
                return iS'
                else
                shrinkLower pivot (iS' + 1) iE'

    shrinkHigher pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iE'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iE'
            if x <= pivot
                then
                return iE'
                else
                shrinkHigher pivot iS' (iE' - 1)

    swapWork = VUM.unsafeSwap work

{-# INLINE lowerBound #-}  
lowerBound :: VUM.IOVector Int -> Int -> IO Int
lowerBound arr x = lowerBound' 0 (n-1)
  where
    n = VUM.length arr
    lowerBound' l r = do
      a <- VUM.unsafeRead arr (n-1)
      if a < x then
        return n
        else if r - l <= 1 then do
        b <- VUM.unsafeRead arr l
        return $ if b < x then r else l
        else do
        let m = div (l+r) 2
        c <- VUM.unsafeRead arr m
        if c < x then
          lowerBound' m r
          else
          lowerBound' l m


{-# INLINE quickSortMVector #-}
quickSortMVector :: VUM.IOVector Int -> IO ()
quickSortMVector vec = do
  qsort 0 (n-1)
  where
    n = VUM.length vec
    {-# INLINE median #-}
    median x y z
      | x < y = if y < z then y else if z < x then x else z
      | otherwise = if z < y then y else if x < z then x else z

    {-# INLINE qsort #-}
    qsort l r = do
      when (l < r) $ do
        piv <- median <$> VUM.unsafeRead vec l <*> VUM.unsafeRead vec (l+(r-l)`div`2) <*> VUM.unsafeRead vec r
        (ll,rr) <- aux piv l r
        qsort l (ll-1)
        qsort (rr+1) r

    {-# INLINE findl #-}
    findl piv i = do
      a <- VUM.unsafeRead vec i
      if a < piv then
        findl piv (i+1)
        else
        return i

    {-# INLINE findr #-}
    findr piv i = do
      a <- VUM.unsafeRead vec i
      if a > piv then
        findr piv (i-1)
        else
        return i

    {-# INLINE aux #-}
    aux piv l r = do
      ll <- findl piv l
      rr <- findr piv r

      if rr > ll then do
        VUM.unsafeSwap vec ll rr
        aux piv (ll+1) (rr-1)
        else
        return (ll,rr)

        j = upperBound (unsafeBit k * 3 - 1 - a) (0, n) sorted
        --notCarriers = binarySearch sorted $ unsafeBit (k + 1) - a
        --i = binarySearch sorted $ unsafeBit k - a
        --j = binarySearch sorted $ unsafeBit (k + 1) + unsafeBit k - a
    in  (notCarriers - i) + (n - j)

type IndType = Int

quicksort :: VUM.STVector s Int -> IndType -> IndType -> ST s ()
quicksort work iStart iEnd
    | iEnd - iStart <= 1 = return ()
    | otherwise =
        do
        pivot <- VUM.unsafeRead work ((iEnd + iStart) `shiftR` 1)
        med <- divide pivot iStart (iEnd - 1)
        quicksort work iStart med
        quicksort work med iEnd
    where
    divide pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            lower <- shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
            higher <- shrinkHigher pivot lower iE'
            if lower >= higher
                then return lower
                else do
                swapWork lower higher
                divide pivot (lower + 1) (higher - 1)

    shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iS'
            if x >= pivot
                then
                return iS'
                else
                shrinkLower pivot (iS' + 1) iE'

    shrinkHigher pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iE'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iE'
            if x <= pivot
                then
                return iE'
                else
                shrinkHigher pivot iS' (iE' - 1)

    swapWork = VUM.unsafeSwap work

-- https://github.com/as-capabl/haskell-qsort-pfm/blob/master/src/UV.hs
type IndType = Int

quicksort :: VUM.STVector s Int -> IndType -> IndType -> ST s ()
quicksort work iStart iEnd
    | iEnd - iStart <= 1 = return ()
    | otherwise =
        do
        pivot <- VUM.unsafeRead work ((iEnd + iStart) `shiftR` 1)
        med <- divide pivot iStart (iEnd - 1)
        quicksort work iStart med
        quicksort work med iEnd
    where
    divide pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            lower <- shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
            higher <- shrinkHigher pivot lower iE'
            if lower >= higher
                then return lower
                else do
                swapWork lower higher
                divide pivot (lower + 1) (higher - 1)

    shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iS'
            if x >= pivot
                then
                return iS'
                else
                shrinkLower pivot (iS' + 1) iE'

    shrinkHigher pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iE'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iE'
            if x <= pivot
                then
                return iE'
                else
                shrinkHigher pivot iS' (iE' - 1)

    swapWork = VUM.unsafeSwap work

import Control.Monad
import Control.Monad.ST
import Data.List
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as B
import qualified Data.Vector as V
import qualified Data.Vector.Mutable as MV

main=do
  n<-readLn::IO Int
  as<-unfoldr (B.readInt.B.dropWhile(==' '))<$>B.getLine::IO[Int]
  bs<-unfoldr (B.readInt.B.dropWhile(==' '))<$>B.getLine::IO[Int]
  let !buf = V.replicate n 0
  --
  print.sum.map (st buf n as bs) $ ts (2^28)
--
ts::Int->[Int]
ts t
  | t==1 = [1]
  | True = t:(ts $ t`div`2)

st::V.Vector Int->Int->[Int]->[Int]->Int->Int
st v' n as bs' t = if even$ sum $ map (f n v t) as then 0 else t
  where !v = bmod v' (t*2) bs'

bmod::V.Vector Int -> Int -> [Int]->V.Vector Int
bmod v' t bs = runST $ do
  v <- V.unsafeThaw v'
  forM_ (zip [0..] bs) $ \(i,b) -> MV.unsafeWrite v i (b`mod`t)
  sortv (<) v 0 (V.length v' - 1)
  V.unsafeFreeze v
--
f::Int->V.Vector Int->Int->Int->Int
f n bs t a' = b2 - b1 + n - b3
  where
    !a = a' `mod` (t*2)
    b1 = bsearch (\i-> (bs V.! i) < (t-a)) (-1,n)
    b2 = bsearch (\i-> (bs V.! i) < (2*t-a)) (-1,n)
    b3 = bsearch (\i-> (bs V.! i) < (3*t-a)) (-1,n)
--    b4 = bsearch (\i-> (bs V.! i) < (4*t-a)) (-1,n)

bsearch f (a,b)
    | a+1 == b = a
    | f m  = bsearch f (m,b)
    | True = bsearch f (a,m)
    where m = (a + (b-a)`div`2)
--
{-# INLINE sortv #-}
sortv :: (a->a->Bool) -> MV.STVector s a -> Int -> Int -> ST s ()
sortv f as b e = do
        l <- MV.unsafeRead as b
        r <- MV.unsafeRead as e
        p <- findP l (b+1) e
        case p of
            Nothing -> return ()
            Just piv -> do
                k <- partv f as piv b e
                sortv f as b (k-1)
                sortv f as k e
    where
        findP a i e
            | i > e = return Nothing
            | True = do
                k <- MV.unsafeRead as i
                case (f a k, f k a) of
                    (True, _) -> return $ Just k
                    (_, True) -> return $ Just a
                    _ -> findP a (i+1) e

partv :: (a->a->Bool) -> MV.STVector s a -> a -> Int -> Int -> ST s Int
partv f as piv b e = do
    MV.unsafeSwap as b e
    l <- findF b
    r <- findT e
    if l <= r then partv f as piv l r
              else return l
    where
        findF i = do
            k <- MV.unsafeRead as i
            if f k piv then findF (i+1) else return i
        findT j = do
            k <- MV.unsafeRead as j
            if f k piv then return j else findT (j-1)

bucketsort :: (Int, Int) -> [Int] -> [Int]
bucketsort = bucketsortBy id

{-# INLINE bucketsortBy #-}
bucketsortBy :: (a -> Int) -> (Int, Int) -> [a] -> [a]
bucketsortBy getkey dom = concatMap reverse . filter (not . null)
    . elems . accumArray (flip (:)) [] dom . map (\x -> (getkey x, x))

{-# INLINE bucketsortDescBy #-}
bucketsortDescBy :: (a -> Int) -> (Int, Int) -> [a] -> [a]
bucketsortDescBy getkey dom = reverse . concat . filter (not . null)
    . elems . accumArray (flip (:)) [] dom . map (\x -> (getkey x, x))

marge :: Ord a => VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> ST s ()
marge u v ret
  | VM.null u = VM.copy ret v
  | VM.null v = VM.copy ret u
  | otherwise = do
        x <- VM.read u 0
        y <- VM.read v 0
        if x > y then marge v u ret else do
            VM.write ret 0 x
            marge (VM.tail u) v (VM.tail ret)

testMarge :: V.Vector Int
testMarge = runST $ do
    x <- V.thaw $ V.fromList ([1, 4] :: [Int])
    y <- V.thaw $ V.fromList ([2, 3] :: [Int])
    res <- VM.new 4
    marge x y res
    V.freeze res

msort :: Ord a => V.Vector a -> V.Vector a
msort v = runST $ do
    v' <- V.thaw v
    work <- VM.new $ VM.length v'
    msort_ v' work
    V.unsafeFreeze v'

msort_ :: Ord a => VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> ST s ()
msort_ v work
  | VM.length v <= 1 = return ()
  | otherwise        = do
        VM.copy lwork lv
        VM.copy rwork rv
        msort_ lwork lv
        msort_ rwork rv
        marge lwork rwork v
        where
            toHalf vm = VM.splitAt (VM.length vm `div` 2) vm
            (lv, rv) = toHalf v
            (lwork, rwork) = toHalf work

binarySearch :: VU.Vector Int -> Int -> Int
binarySearch xs y = go 0 $ VU.length xs where
    go l r
        | l == r = l
        | x < y = go (m + 1) r
        | x >= y = go l m
        where m = (r + l) `shiftR` 1
              x = xs `VU.unsafeIndex` m

upperBoundImpl key (l, r) f =
    let mid = (l + r) `unsafeShiftR` 1
    in  if r - l <= 1 then r else
        if f `VU.unsafeIndex` mid <= key
            then upperBoundImpl key (mid, r) f
            else upperBoundImpl key (l, mid) f

upperBound :: Int -> (Int, Int) -> VU.Vector Int -> Int
upperBound key (l, r) = upperBoundImpl key (l - 1, r)

        notCarriers = binarySearch sorted $ unsafeBit (k + 1) - a
        i = binarySearch sorted $ unsafeBit k - a
        j = binarySearch sorted $ unsafeBit (k + 1) + unsafeBit k - a
    in  (notCarriers - i) + (n - j)

-- https://github.com/as-capabl/haskell-qsort-pfm/blob/master/src/UV.hs
type IndType = Int

quicksort :: VUM.STVector s Int -> IndType -> IndType -> ST s ()
quicksort work iStart iEnd
    | iEnd - iStart <= 1 = return ()
    | otherwise =
        do
        pivot <- VUM.unsafeRead work ((iEnd + iStart) `shiftR` 1)
        med <- divide pivot iStart (iEnd - 1)
        quicksort work iStart med
        quicksort work med iEnd
    where
    divide pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            lower <- shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
            higher <- shrinkHigher pivot lower iE'
            if lower >= higher
                then return lower
                else do
                swapWork lower higher
                divide pivot (lower + 1) (higher - 1)

    shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iS'
            if x >= pivot
                then
                return iS'
                else
                shrinkLower pivot (iS' + 1) iE'

    shrinkHigher pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iE'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iE'
            if x <= pivot
                then
                return iE'
                else
                shrinkHigher pivot iS' (iE' - 1)

    swapWork = VUM.unsafeSwap work

{-# OPTIONS_GHC -O2 -funbox-strict-fields #-}
import           Control.Monad.ST            (ST)
import           Data.Bits                   (shiftL, shiftR, testBit, (.&.))
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8       as BC
import           Data.Maybe                  (fromJust)
import qualified Data.Vector.Unboxed         as V
import qualified Data.Vector.Unboxed.Mutable as VM


main :: IO ()
main = do
  n <- readLn
  as <- getInts
  bs <- getInts
  print $ solve n as bs

solve :: Int -> [Int] -> [Int] -> Int
solve n as bs = sum $ map kXorBit [0 .. 28] where
  bv = V.fromList bs
  kXorBit k = if odd s then t else 0 where
    t = 1 `shiftL` k
    t2 = 1 `shiftL` (k + 1)
    cs = sort' $ V.map modT2 bv
    s = sum $ map count as
    mask = t2 - 1
    modT2 = (mask .&.)
    count a = (t12 - t01) + (n - t23) where
      t01 = binarySearch cs $ t - a'
      t12 = binarySearch cs $ t2 - a'
      t23 = binarySearch cs $ 3 * t - a'
      a' = modT2 a

binarySearch :: V.Vector Int -> Int -> Int
binarySearch xs y = go 0 $ V.length xs where
  go l r
    | l == r = l
    | x < y = go (m + 1) r
    | x >= y = go l m
    where m = (r + l) `shiftR` 1
          x = xs `V.unsafeIndex` m

odd' :: Int -> Bool
odd' n = testBit n 0

readInts :: BC.ByteString -> [Int]
readInts = map (fst . fromJust . BC.readInt) . BC.words

getInts :: IO [Int]
getInts = readInts <$> BC.getLine

sort' :: V.Vector Int -> V.Vector Int
sort' = V.modify (\v -> quicksort v 0 (VM.length v))

-- https://github.com/as-capabl/haskell-qsort-pfm/blob/master/src/UV.hs
type IndType = Int

quicksort :: VM.STVector s Int -> IndType -> IndType -> ST s ()
quicksort work iStart iEnd
    | iEnd - iStart <= 1 = return ()
    | otherwise =
      do
        pivot <- VM.unsafeRead work ((iEnd + iStart) `shiftR` 1)
        med <- divide pivot iStart (iEnd - 1)
        quicksort work iStart med
        quicksort work med iEnd
  where
    divide pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
          do
            lower <- shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
            higher <- shrinkHigher pivot lower iE'
            if lower >= higher
              then do
                return lower
              else do
                swapWork lower higher
                divide pivot (lower + 1) (higher - 1)

    shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
          do
            x <- VM.unsafeRead work iS'
            if x >= pivot
              then
                return iS'
              else
                shrinkLower pivot (iS' + 1) iE'

    shrinkHigher pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iE'
        | otherwise =
          do
            x <- VM.unsafeRead work iE'
            if x <= pivot
              then
                return iE'
              else
                shrinkHigher pivot iS' (iE' - 1)

    swapWork i j = VM.unsafeSwap work i j

bucketsortBy getkey dom = concatMap reverse . filter (not . null)
    . elems . accumArray (flip (:)) [] dom . map (\x -> (getkey x, x))

{-# INLINE bucketsortDescBy #-}
bucketsortDescBy :: (a -> Int) -> (Int, Int) -> [a] -> [a]
bucketsortDescBy getkey dom = reverse . concat . filter (not . null)
    . elems . accumArray (flip (:)) [] dom . map (\x -> (getkey x, x))

marge :: Ord a => VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> ST s ()
marge u v ret
  | VM.null u = VM.copy ret v
  | VM.null v = VM.copy ret u
  | otherwise = do
        x <- VM.read u 0
        y <- VM.read v 0
        if x > y then marge v u ret else do
            VM.write ret 0 x
            marge (VM.tail u) v (VM.tail ret)

testMarge :: V.Vector Int
testMarge = runST $ do
    x <- V.thaw $ V.fromList ([1, 4] :: [Int])
    y <- V.thaw $ V.fromList ([2, 3] :: [Int])
    res <- VM.new 4
    marge x y res
    V.freeze res

msort :: Ord a => V.Vector a -> V.Vector a
msort v = runST $ do
    v' <- V.thaw v
    work <- VM.new $ VM.length v'
    msort_ v' work
    V.unsafeFreeze v'

msort_ :: Ord a => VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> ST s ()
msort_ v work
  | VM.length v <= 1 = return ()
  | otherwise        = do
        VM.copy lwork lv
        VM.copy rwork rv
        msort_ lwork lv
        msort_ rwork rv
        marge lwork rwork v
        where
            toHalf vm = VM.splitAt (VM.length vm `div` 2) vm
            (lv, rv) = toHalf v
            (lwork, rwork) = toHalf work

upperBoundImpl key (l, r) f =
    let mid = (l + r) `unsafeShiftR` 1
    in  if r - l <= 1 then r else
        if f `VU.unsafeIndex` mid <= key
            then upperBoundImpl key (mid, r) f
            else upperBoundImpl key (l, mid) f

upperBound :: Int -> (Int, Int) -> VU.Vector Int -> Int
upperBound key (l, r) = upperBoundImpl key (l - 1, r)

unsafeBit = (1 `unsafeShiftL`)

xorOnFigure :: Int -> Int -> VU.Vector Int -> Int
xorOnFigure a k sorted =
    let n = VU.length sorted
        notCarriers = upperBound (unsafeBit (k + 1) - 1 - a) (0, n) sorted
        i = upperBound (unsafeBit k - 1 - a) (0, notCarriers) sorted
        j = upperBound (unsafeBit k * 3 - 1 - a) (notCarriers, n) sorted
        {-notCarriers = binarySearch sorted (0, n) $ bit (k + 1)
        i = binarySearch sorted (0, notCarriers) $ bit k
        j = binarySearch sorted (notCarriers, n) $ bit (k + 1) + bit k-}
    in  if testBit ((notCarriers - i) + (n - j)) 0 then 1 else 0

eachFigure :: Int -> [Int] -> [Int] -> Int
eachFigure k as sortedBs =
    let v = VU.fromList $ (.&. (unsafeBit (k + 1) - 1)) <$> sortedBs
        f a = xorOnFigure a k v
    in  foldr1 xor $ map f $! (.&. (unsafeBit (k + 1) - 1)) <$> as

eachFigure' :: [Int] -> [Int] -> Int -> Int
eachFigure' as bs k =
    let v = sort' $ VU.fromList $ (.&. (unsafeBit (k + 1) - 1)) <$> bs
        f a = xorOnFigure a k v
    in  if odd $ sum $ map f $ (.&. (unsafeBit (k + 1) - 1)) <$> as
        then unsafeBit k
        else 0

import           Control.Monad.ST            (ST, runST)
import           Data.Bits                   (shiftL, shiftR, testBit, (.&.))

main :: IO ()
main = do
  n <- readLn
  as <- getInts
  bs <- getInts
  print $ solve n as bs

solve :: Int -> [Int] -> [Int] -> Int
solve n as bs = sum $ map kXorBit [0 .. 28] where
  bv = V.fromList bs
  kXorBit k = if odd s then t else 0 where
    t = 1 `shiftL` k
    t2 = 1 `shiftL` (k + 1)
    cs = sort' $ V.map (`mod` t2) bv
    s = sum $ map count as
    count a = (t12 - t01) + (n - t23) where
      t01 = binarySearch cs $ t - a'
      t12 = binarySearch cs $ t2 - a'
      t23 = binarySearch cs $ 3 * t - a'
      a' = a `mod` t2

binarySearch :: V.Vector Int -> Int -> Int
binarySearch xs y = go 0 $ V.length xs where
  go l r
    | l == r = l
    | x < y = go (m + 1) r
    | x >= y = go l m
    where m = (r + l) `shiftR` 1
          x = xs V.! m

odd' :: Int -> Bool
odd' n = testBit n 0

readInts :: BC.ByteString -> [Int]
readInts = map (fst . fromJust . BC.readInt) . BC.words

getInts :: IO [Int]
getInts = readInts <$> BC.getLine

sort' :: V.Vector Int -> V.Vector Int
sort' xs = runST $ do
  v <- V.thaw $ xs
  quicksort v 0 $ VM.length v
  V.freeze v

-- https://github.com/as-capabl/haskell-qsort-pfm/blob/master/src/UV.hs
type IndType = Int

quicksort :: VM.STVector s Int -> IndType -> IndType -> ST s ()
quicksort work iStart iEnd
    | iEnd - iStart <= 1 = return ()
    | otherwise =
      do
        pivot <- VM.unsafeRead work ((iEnd + iStart) `shiftR` 1)
        med <- divide pivot iStart (iEnd - 1)
        quicksort work iStart med
        quicksort work med iEnd
  where
    divide pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
          do
            lower <- shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
            higher <- shrinkHigher pivot lower iE'
            if lower >= higher
              then do
                return lower
              else do
                swapWork lower higher
                divide pivot (lower + 1) (higher - 1)

    shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
          do
            x <- VM.unsafeRead work iS'
            if x >= pivot
              then
                return iS'
              else
                shrinkLower pivot (iS' + 1) iE'

    shrinkHigher pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iE'
        | otherwise =
          do
            x <- VM.unsafeRead work iE'
            if x <= pivot
              then
                return iE'
              else
                shrinkHigher pivot iS' (iE' - 1)

    swapWork i j = VM.unsafeSwap work i j

marge :: Ord a => VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> ST s ()
marge u v ret
  | VM.null u = VM.copy ret v
  | VM.null v = VM.copy ret u
  | otherwise = do
        x <- VM.read u 0
        y <- VM.read v 0
        if x > y then marge v u ret else do
            VM.write ret 0 x
            marge (VM.tail u) v (VM.tail ret)

    V.freeze res

msort :: Ord a => V.Vector a -> V.Vector a
msort v = runST $ do
    v' <- V.thaw v
    work <- VM.new $ VM.length v'
    msort_ v' work
    V.unsafeFreeze v'

msort_ :: Ord a => VM.STVector s a -> VM.STVector s a -> ST s ()
msort_ v work
  | VM.length v <= 1 = return ()
  | otherwise        = do
        VM.copy lwork lv
        VM.copy rwork rv
        msort_ lwork lv
        msort_ rwork rv
        marge lwork rwork v
        where
            toHalf vm = VM.splitAt (VM.length vm `div` 2) vm
            (lv, rv) = toHalf v
            (lwork, rwork) = toHalf work

    go l r

xorOnFigure :: Int -> Int -> VU.Vector Int -> Int

    let n = VU.length sorted
        --notCarriers = upperBound (unsafeBit (k + 1) - 1 - a) (0, n) sorted

        i = binarySearch sorted (0, n) $ unsafeBit k - a

-- https://github.com/as-capabl/haskell-qsort-pfm/blob/master/src/UV.hs
type IndType = Int

quicksort :: VUM.STVector s Int -> IndType -> IndType -> ST s ()
quicksort work iStart iEnd
    | iEnd - iStart <= 1 = return ()
    | otherwise =
        do
        pivot <- VUM.unsafeRead work ((iEnd + iStart) `shiftR` 1)
        med <- divide pivot iStart (iEnd - 1)
        quicksort work iStart med
        quicksort work med iEnd
    where
    divide pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            lower <- shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
            higher <- shrinkHigher pivot lower iE'
            if lower >= higher
                then return lower
                else do
                swapWork lower higher
                divide pivot (lower + 1) (higher - 1)

    shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iS'
            if x >= pivot
                then
                return iS'
                else
                shrinkLower pivot (iS' + 1) iE'

    shrinkHigher pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iE'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iE'
            if x <= pivot
                then
                return iE'
                else
                shrinkHigher pivot iS' (iE' - 1)

    swapWork = VUM.unsafeSwap work

-- keyより大きいところのインデックス
-- 広義単調増加関数であること
upperBoundImpl :: Word -> (Int, Int) -> (Int -> Word) -> Int
upperBoundImpl key (l, r) f =
    let mid = shiftR (l + r) 1
    in  if r - l <= 1 then r else
        if f mid <= key
            then upperBoundImpl key (mid, r) f
            else upperBoundImpl key (l, mid) f

upperBound :: Word -> (Int, Int) -> (Int -> Word) -> Int
upperBound key (l, r) f = upperBoundImpl key (l - 1, r) f'
    where f' i = if i < l then minBound :: Word else f i

test :: IO()
test = print $ upperBound 1 (0, 5) $ ((listArray (0, 4) [1, 1, 1, 1, 1] :: Array Int Word) !)

xorOnFigure :: Int -> Int -> (Int -> Word) -> Word
xorOnFigure n k sorted =
    let notCarriers = upperBound (bit (k + 1) - 1) (0, n) sorted
        i = upperBound (bit k - 1) (0, notCarriers) sorted
        j = upperBound (bit (k + 1) + bit k - 1) (notCarriers, n) sorted
        cnt = (notCarriers - i) + (n - j)
    in  if odd cnt then bit k else 0

eachFigure :: Int -> [Word] -> [Word] -> Word
eachFigure k as sortedBs =
    let v = VU.fromList $ (.&. (bit (k + 1) - 1)) <$> sortedBs
        f a = xorOnFigure (length sortedBs) k $ (a +) . (v VU.!)
    in  foldr1 xor $ map f $ (.&. (bit (k + 1) - 1)) <$> as

build :: Int -> [Word] -> [[Word]]
build 29 _ = []
build k bs = sorted : build (k + 1) sorted
    where sorted = bucketsortBy (\w -> if testBit w k then 1 else 0) (0, 1) bs :: [Word]

solve :: Int -> [Int] -> [Int] -> Int
solve n as bs = sum $ map kXorBit [0 .. 28] where
  bv = V.fromList bs
  kXorBit k = if odd s then t else 0 where
    t = 1 `shiftL` k
    t2 = 1 `shiftL` (k + 1)
    cs = sort' $ V.map modT2 bv
    s = sum $ map count as
    mask = t2 - 1
    modT2 = (mask .&.)
    count a = (t12 - t01) + (n - t23) where
      t01 = binarySearch cs $ t - a'
      t12 = binarySearch cs $ t2 - a'
      t23 = binarySearch cs $ 3 * t - a'
      a' = modT2 a

binarySearch :: V.Vector Int -> Int -> Int
binarySearch xs y = go 0 $ V.length xs where
  go l r
    | l == r = l
    | x < y = go (m + 1) r
    | x >= y = go l m
    where m = (r + l) `shiftR` 1
          x = xs `V.unsafeIndex` m

odd' :: Int -> Bool
odd' n = testBit n 0

  V.freeze v

-- https://github.com/as-capabl/haskell-qsort-pfm/blob/master/src/UV.hs
type IndType = Int

quicksort :: VM.STVector s Int -> IndType -> IndType -> ST s ()
quicksort work iStart iEnd
    | iEnd - iStart <= 1 = return ()
    | otherwise =
      do
        pivot <- VM.unsafeRead work ((iEnd + iStart) `shiftR` 1)
        med <- divide pivot iStart (iEnd - 1)
        quicksort work iStart med
        quicksort work med iEnd
  where
    divide pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
          do
            lower <- shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
            higher <- shrinkHigher pivot lower iE'
            if lower >= higher
              then do
                return lower
              else do
                swapWork lower higher
                divide pivot (lower + 1) (higher - 1)

    shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
          do
            x <- VM.unsafeRead work iS'
            if x >= pivot
              then
                return iS'
              else
                shrinkLower pivot (iS' + 1) iE'

    shrinkHigher pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iE'
        | otherwise =
          do
            x <- VM.unsafeRead work iE'
            if x <= pivot
              then
                return iE'
              else
                shrinkHigher pivot iS' (iE' - 1)

    swapWork i j = VM.unsafeSwap work i j

st::Int->[Int]->V.Vector Int->Int->Int
st n as bs' t = if even$ sum $ map (f n v t (t*2-1)) as then 0 else t
  where !v = bmod (t*2) bs'

bmod::Int -> V.Vector Int -> V.Vector Int
bmod t bs = runST $ do
  v <- V.unsafeThaw bs :: ST s (MV.STVector s Int)
  sortv (\a b -> ((a .&. (t-1))<(b .&. (t-1)))) v 0 (V.length bs - 1)
  V.unsafeFreeze v
--
f::Int->V.Vector Int->Int->Int->Int->Int
f n bs t tm a' = b2 - b1 + b4 - b3
  where
    !a = a' `mod` (t*2)
    b1 = bsearch (\i-> ((bs V.! i) .&. tm) < (t-a)) (-1,n)
    b2 = bsearch (\i-> ((bs V.! i) .&. tm) < (2*t-a)) (-1,n)
    b3 = bsearch (\i-> ((bs V.! i) .&. tm) < (3*t-a)) (-1,n)
    b4 = bsearch (\i-> ((bs V.! i) .&. tm) < (4*t-a)) (-1,n)

bsearch f (a,b)
    | a+1 == b = a
    | f m  = bsearch f (m,b)
    | True = bsearch f (a,m)
    where m = (a + (b-a)`div`2)
--
{-# INLINE sortv #-}
sortv :: (Int->Int->Bool) -> MV.STVector s Int -> Int -> Int -> ST s ()
sortv f as b e = do
        l <- MV.unsafeRead as b
        r <- MV.unsafeRead as e
        p <- findP l (b+1) e
        case p of
            Nothing -> return ()
            Just piv -> do
                k <- partv f as piv b e
                sortv f as b (k-1)
                sortv f as k e
    where
        findP a i e
            | i > e = return Nothing
            | True = do
                k <- MV.unsafeRead as i
                case (f a k, f k a) of
                    (True, _) -> return $ Just k
                    (_, True) -> return $ Just a
                    _ -> findP a (i+1) e

partv :: (Int->Int->Bool) -> MV.STVector s Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> ST s Int
partv f as piv b e = do
    MV.unsafeSwap as b e
    l <- findF b
    r <- findT e
    if l <= r then partv f as piv l r
              else return l
    where
        findF i = do
            k <- MV.unsafeRead as i
            if f k piv then findF (i+1) else return i
        findT j = do
            k <- MV.unsafeRead as j
            if f k piv then return j else findT (j-1)

type IndType = Int

quicksort :: VUM.STVector s Int -> IndType -> IndType -> ST s ()
quicksort work iStart iEnd
    | iEnd - iStart <= 1 = return ()
    | otherwise =
        do
        pivot <- VUM.unsafeRead work ((iEnd + iStart) `shiftR` 1)
        med <- divide pivot iStart (iEnd - 1)
        quicksort work iStart med
        quicksort work med iEnd
    where
    divide pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            lower <- shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
            higher <- shrinkHigher pivot lower iE'
            if lower >= higher
                then return lower
                else do
                swapWork lower higher
                divide pivot (lower + 1) (higher - 1)

    shrinkLower pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iS'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iS'
            if x >= pivot
                then
                return iS'
                else
                shrinkLower pivot (iS' + 1) iE'

    shrinkHigher pivot iS' iE'
        | iS' > iE' = return iE'
        | otherwise =
            do
            x <- VUM.unsafeRead work iE'
            if x <= pivot
                then
                return iE'
                else
                shrinkHigher pivot iS' (iE' - 1)

    swapWork = VUM.unsafeSwap work
